summary: Propose a bounded, explicit resume35 continuation mode for tests/board-p4m-formal60.sh. It adds only resume35, leaves short/compare/all/formal60 and locate_new_startup untouched, runs exactly the frozen flat cases 26..60 (b09-g0, b09-g1000, then b10..b20 unchanged), and performs a read-only preflight before any resume DMA. The preflight requires exact kernel 6.5.0-rc2-00089-gefd9461d6459, path_observe=Y and taint=0 through existing gates, current dmesg max startup seq exactly 37, a complete seq37 startup+batch_time record with a_begin_ns=3600085892000, the archived /tmp/p4m-formal60-215406 params matching that kernel, and archived old25 JSON plus seq37 dmesg records rechecked through existing production startup/batch-time/JSON validators. It never edits the old run, never uses dmesg -c, never retries, and never claims full60 completion. New host test coverage is proposed in tests/test_p4m_formal60_resume.py. Acceptance remains pending parent-side offline25 audit and actual board run; this output does not claim any pass.

# Extract the unique idma_batch_start seq=37 and the matching
# idma_batch_obs part=time seq=37 record from a dmesg snapshot. This is a
# read-only helper for the resume35 preflight; the source file is never edited.
extract_resume_seq37() {
    ers_id=$1
    ers_src=$2
    ers_startup=$3
    ers_batchtime=$4

    if [ ! -r "$ers_src" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=unreadable_dmesg file=$ers_src" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    ers_n_start=$(awk -v s="$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ" '
        /idma_batch_start / {
            for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++)
                if ($i == ("seq=" s)) n++
        }
        END { print n + 0 }' "$ers_src")
    case "$ers_n_start" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*)
            echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=seq37_startup_count_unreadable file=$ers_src" >&2
            return 1 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$ers_n_start" != "1" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=seq37_startup_count want=1 got=$ers_n_start file=$ers_src" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    ers_n_bt=$(awk -v s="$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ" '
        /idma_batch_obs / && /part=time/ {
            for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++)
                if ($i == ("seq=" s)) n++
        }
        END { print n + 0 }' "$ers_src")
    case "$ers_n_bt" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*)
            echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=seq37_batch_time_count_unreadable file=$ers_src" >&2
            return 1 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$ers_n_bt" != "1" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=seq37_batch_time_count want=1 got=$ers_n_bt file=$ers_src" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    if ! awk -v s="$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ" '
        /idma_batch_start / {
            for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++)
                if ($i == ("seq=" s)) { print $0; exit }
        }' "$ers_src" > "$ers_startup"; then
        echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=seq37_startup_extract file=$ers_src" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! awk -v s="$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ" '
        /idma_batch_obs / && /part=time/ {
            for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++)
                if ($i == ("seq=" s)) { print $0; exit }
        }' "$ers_src" > "$ers_batchtime"; then
        echo "P4M: resume=$ers_id preflight_failed=seq37_batch_time_extract file=$ers_src" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

# Reuse the normal production startup/batch-time/JSON checks on one extracted
# seq37 boundary. rcs_json may be empty when only the dmesg record is checked.
resume_check_seq37_record() {
    rcs_id=$1
    rcs_src=$2
    rcs_startup=$3
    rcs_batchtime=$4
    rcs_json=$5

    if ! extract_resume_seq37 "$rcs_id" "$rcs_src" "$rcs_startup" "$rcs_batchtime"; then
        return 1
    fi
    if ! rcs_sfields=$(verify_startup "$rcs_id" "$rcs_startup" "pair"); then
        return 1
    fi
    echo "P4M: resume=$rcs_id startup $rcs_sfields" >&2
    if ! verify_batch_time "$rcs_id" "$rcs_batchtime" "$LONG_TRANSFERS" "$A_DID"; then
        return 1
    fi
    rcs_anchor=$(int_of "$(dmget "$rcs_startup" a_begin_ns)")
    if [ "$rcs_anchor" != "$RESUME_ANCHOR_A_BEGIN_NS" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume=$rcs_id preflight_failed=anchor_a_begin_ns got=$rcs_anchor want=$RESUME_ANCHOR_A_BEGIN_NS" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [ -n "$rcs_json" ]; then
        if ! check_case_json "$rcs_id" "$rcs_json" "p4m" "$LONG_TRANSFERS" "$A_DID" "$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ"; then
            return 1
        fi
    fi
    return 0
}

# Read-only resume35 preflight. It collects one current dmesg snapshot and checks
# that the archived seq37 boundary still exists before the first new DMA. It
# never edits the original output directory.
resume_preflight() {
    rp_dmesg="$OUT/resume-preflight.dmesg.raw"
    rp_startup="$OUT/resume-preflight-seq37.startup"
    rp_batchtime="$OUT/resume-preflight-seq37.batch_time"
    rp_old_startup="$OUT/resume-old25-seq37.startup"
    rp_old_batchtime="$OUT/resume-old25-seq37.batch_time"
    rp_orig_params="$RESUME_ORIGINAL/params.txt"
    rp_orig_json="$RESUME_ORIGINAL/$RESUME_ORIGINAL_CASE.json"
    rp_orig_dmesg="$RESUME_ORIGINAL/$RESUME_ORIGINAL_CASE.dmesg.raw"

    if [ "$kernel_release" != "$KERNEL_RESUME_EXACT" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=kernel_exact got=$kernel_release want=$KERNEL_RESUME_EXACT" >&2
        return 5
    fi
    case "$kernel_release" in
        *"$KERNEL_RESUME_MATCH"*) ;;
        *)
            echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=kernel_match got=$kernel_release want=*$KERNEL_RESUME_MATCH*" >&2
            return 5 ;;
    esac

    if ! dmesg > "$rp_dmesg" 2> "$OUT/resume-preflight.dmesg.err"; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=dmesg_collection" >&2
        return 4
    fi
    rp_max=$(startup_max_seq "$rp_dmesg")
    case "$rp_max" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*)
            echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=startup_max_seq_unreadable file=$rp_dmesg" >&2
            return 5 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$rp_max" != "$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=startup_max_seq want=$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ got=$rp_max; stop for manual review, no continuation" >&2
        return 5
    fi

    if ! resume_check_seq37_record "resume-current" "$rp_dmesg" "$rp_startup" "$rp_batchtime" ""; then
        return 5
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$RESUME_ORIGINAL" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=missing_original_dir path=$RESUME_ORIGINAL" >&2
        return 5
    fi
    if [ ! -r "$rp_orig_params" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=missing_original_params path=$rp_orig_params" >&2
        return 5
    fi
    rp_old_kernel=$(awk -F= '$1 == "kernel_release" { print $2; exit }' "$rp_orig_params")
    if [ "$rp_old_kernel" != "$KERNEL_RESUME_EXACT" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=original_kernel got=$rp_old_kernel want=$KERNEL_RESUME_EXACT" >&2
        return 5
    fi

    if [ ! -r "$rp_orig_json" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=missing_old25_json path=$rp_orig_json" >&2
        return 5
    fi
    if [ ! -r "$rp_orig_dmesg" ]; then
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=missing_old25_dmesg path=$rp_orig_dmesg" >&2
        return 5
    fi
    if ! resume_check_seq37_record "resume-old25" "$rp_orig_dmesg" "$rp_old_startup" "$rp_old_batchtime" "$rp_orig_json"; then
        return 5
    fi

    {
        echo "resume35_preflight=ok"
        echo "original_run_id=$RESUME_ORIGINAL_ID"
        echo "original_output=$RESUME_ORIGINAL"
        echo "original_case=$RESUME_ORIGINAL_CASE"
        echo "anchor_seq=$RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ"
        echo "anchor_a_begin_ns=$RESUME_ANCHOR_A_BEGIN_NS"
        echo "kernel_release=$kernel_release"
        echo "current_dmesg=$rp_dmesg"
        if [ -r /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id ]; then
            printf 'current_boot_id='
            cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null || echo unknown
        else
            echo "current_boot_id=unknown"
        fi
        if [ -r /proc/uptime ]; then
            printf 'current_uptime='
            cat /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || echo unknown
        else
            echo "current_uptime=unknown"
        fi
    } > "$OUT/resume35-preflight.txt" || {
        echo "P4M: resume35 preflight_failed=metadata_write" >&2
        return 4
    }
    return 0
}

run_formal_resume() {
    run_case "formal-b09-g0" "P8g0" "$LONG_TRANSFERS" "$LONG_WARMUP" || return $?
    run_case "formal-b09-g1000" "P8g1000" "$LONG_TRANSFERS" "$LONG_WARMUP" || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 10 0 2000 1000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 11 2000 1000 0 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 12 1000 0 2000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 13 0 1000 2000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 14 1000 2000 0 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 15 2000 0 1000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 16 0 2000 1000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 17 2000 1000 0 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 18 1000 0 2000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 19 0 1000 2000 || return $?
    run_formal_triplet 20 2000 1000 0 || return $?
    return 0
}

content: '''Host-only checks for the explicit resume35 continuation mode.
No board, device, DMA, HPM or FPGA access is performed. The tests extract the
real sequence and preflight shell functions from tests/board-p4m-formal60.sh and
run them under stubbed commands. They never write to /tmp/p4m-formal60-215406 or
raise AssertionError('production function not found: ' + name)
parts.append('    if [ "$count" = "%d" ]; then return 1; fi\n' % fail_at)
lines = [line for line in self.call_log.read_text().splitlines() if line]
expected = ['%s|%s|4096|256' % item for item in EXPECTED_RESUME_SEQUENCE]
' v_did=10 a_did=11 attempted=1 has_a=1 a_triggered=1 v_triggered=1'
' a_id=7 v_id=9 a_begin_ns=%s a_end_ns=%s v_begin_ns=%s v_end_ns=%s'
old = old_dir if old_dir is not None else self.old_dir
current = current_dmesg if current_dmesg is not None else self.current_dmesg

checks: Run `sh -n tests/board-p4m-formal60.sh` to verify shell syntax after both workers apply changes.
Run `python3 -m unittest tests/test_p4m_formal60_resume.py` on the host; this must not touch /dev/idma0, /tmp/p4m-formal60-215406, FPGA, SD, or any board path.

Run the new preflight against the archived offline25 evidence under out/p4m-formal60-recovery-20260920/evidence/p4m-formal60-215406 and confirm old25 JSON success/status=0/p4m.sequence=37 plus seq37 startup/batch-time records validate with existing production checks.

Before any actual resume35 board run, manually confirm current dmesg still has max startup seq 37 and the exact seq37 record with a_begin_ns=3600085892000; if it has rotated out, stop for manual review.
After actual board execution, parent must merge 24 runtime-passed + offline b09-g2000 + 35 resume35 cases and separately audit/qualify the full 60. This proposal does not claim that audit has passed.
risks: The preflight intentionally fails closed if current dmesg no longer contains the seq37 boundary; Linux idle time can rotate the ring and force manual review.
The exact kernel string is hardcoded to 6.5.0-rc2-00089-gefd9461d6459; any board kernel rebuild or release change will fail closed by design.
The anchor a_begin_ns=3600085892000 is taken from the supplied archived session boundary; if the real archived seq37 record differs, preflight will fail.

The resume35 path uses a new read-only seq37 extraction helper rather than the other worker's locate_new_startup ringwrap fix. This avoids touching that function and is independent of its authorship, but the parent should confirm the two interpretations agree during offline audit.
The new host test file assumes tests/board-p4m-formal60.sh exists after the other worker creates it from the original with only the locate_new_startup ringwrap fix.
No actual board DMA, FPGA, SD write, reboot, or acceptance run is performed by this proposal; all board acceptance remains parent-led and unclaimed.
